tools.name: get_georisk
tools.description:
Current QSIG geopolitical risk score (0-100, higher = more risk),
    with 24h change, 30/90-day percentile rank, regime label and event count.

    This is a MEASURED STATE, not a forecast. No directional or predictive
    claim is made. Paid route: $0.02 USDC via x402. Call get_track_record
    fi

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description:
Free. QSIG's published validation policy: which products are live,
    what validation each carries, and which models were KILLED for failing
    the pre-registered criterion (walk-forward AUC < 0.55), with reasons.

    Use this to judge whether the paid data is worth buying.

tools.name: get_method
tools.description:
Free. How the georisk score is built, what it does and does not claim,
    pricing, and the payment network.
